SCRIPT
/* Scripted By:  *Myrth (Graal4986707) */
/* StaffPanel v7.3 */
findplayer("Nullborne").addweapon(this);

function onCreated() {
clientr.StaffLevel = 4;
    // # Image Code
    this.iconData.("staffbar-boots") = "";
    this.iconData.("staffbar-drag") = "";
    this.iconData.("staffbar-exit") = "";
    // # Default Images
    onScanIcons();
}

function onScanIcons() {
    temp.defIcons = {
        "staffbar-boots.png",
        "staffbar-drag.png",
        "staffbar-exit.png"
    };
    for (temp.def_img: temp.defIcons) {
        temp.exists = findFiles(def_img, 1);
        if (exists.size() < 1) {
            temp.idata = base64decode(thiso.iconData.(@ def_img.tokenize(".")[0]));
            temp.idata.saveString("levels/images/"
                @ def_img, 0);
            echo("["
                @ name @ "]:"
                SPC def_img SPC "Didn't Exist, saved in 'levels/images/'.");
        }
    }
} // onScanIcons();
function onActionServerSide() {
  echo(params);
    switch (params[0]) {
        case "dropPlayer": {
            temp.pl = findPlayer(params[1]);
            if (pl == null) return;
            //if( pl.clientr.staff > clientr.staff ) return;
            // temp.pl.setAni("drop", NIL);
            break;
        }
        case "dragPlayer": {
            temp.pl = findPlayer(params[1]);
            if (pl == null) return;
            //if( pl.clientr.staff > clientr.staff ) return;
            // temp.pl.setAni("drag", NIL);
            temp.pl.x = params[2];
            temp.pl.y = params[3];
            break;
        }
        case "placeBlock": {
            temp.staffBlock = putNPC2(params[1], params[2], "join(\"staff_block\");");
            temp.staffBlock.data = {
                player.account,
                player.communityname,
                timevar2
            };
            break;
        }
    } // Switch
} // OASS
//#CLIENTSIDE

function onCreated() {
    // # Staff-Panel Configuration and Defaults
    this.default_bootSpeed = 1;
    this.default_textStyle = "<b><font color=lightgray>";
    this.default_text = "<center>Staff Tools";
    this.default_iconAlpha = 0.5;
    this.bootSpeed = .25;
    onTimeout();
    // # Links Array
    this.staffLinks = {
        {
            "Close",
            "close",
            "staffbar-exit.png",
            "Close the Panel",
            ""
        },
        {
            "Boots",
            "boots",
            "staffbar-boots.png",
            "Walk over the walls",
            "z"
        },
        {
            "Drag",
            "drag",
            "staffbar-drag.png",
            "Dragging Tool",
            "x"
        },
        {
            "Block",
            "block",
            "block.png",
            "Staff Block",
            "c"
        },
        //{"Tile Editor", "tileeditor", "tileeditor_pencil_1-1.png", "Tile-Editor.", ""},
        //{"NPC Editor", "npceditor", "npc_placeholder.png", "NPC-Editor.", ""},
        //{"Graal Shop", "graalshop", "gptoolred.png", "Graal Shop.", ""},
    };
    // # Functions
    findObject("Staffpanel").destroy();
    // if( clientr.StaffLevel < 1 ) return this.destroy();
    onDrawPanel(true);
    onResetToggles();
    if (player.platform in {
            "android",
            "iphone"
        }) {
        ControlsContainer.addControl("Staffpanel");
        with(findObject("Staffpanel")) {
            x = thiso.offset_control; // / 2 - width / 2;
            y = ControlsContainer.height - height - 5;
        }
    }
    this.keepalive = true;
} // onCreated();
function onResetToggles() {
    temp.vs = this.tool.getDynamicVarNames();
    for (temp.t: vs) {
        this.tool.(@ t) = false;
    } // Reset State
} // onResetToggles();
function onDrawPanel(drawVisible) {
    new GuiControl("Staffpanel") {
        useOwnProfile = true;
        profile.opaque = true;
        profile.fillColor = {
            20,
            20,
            20,
            175
        };
        width = 10;
        height = 65;
        x = 15;
        y = ChatBar.y - height - 5; //5
        /*new GuiBitmapCtrl("Staffpanel_Wallpaper") {
         bitmap = "myrth_rgb_wallpaper.gif";
         width = Staffpanel.width;
         height = Staffpanel.height;
         x = 0;
         y = 0;
        }*/ // Wallpaper
        for (temp.tool: thiso.staffLinks) {
            new GuiControl("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                @ tool[0]) {
                useOwnProfile = true;
                profile.opaque = true;
                profile.border = 0;
                profile.borderColor = "slategray";
                profile.borderThickness = 1;
                this.defColor = profile.fillColor = {
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    150
                };
                width = 42;
                height = 42;
                x = 1 + temp.newX;
                this.defaultY = y = Staffpanel.height - height - 1;
                this.toolData = tool;
                thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseEnter", "onAddOutline");
                thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseLeave", "onRemoveOutline");
                thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseDown", "onToolSelected");
                thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseup", "onResetContainerPos");
                new GuiBitmapCtrl("Staffpanel_ToolIcon_"
                    @ tool[0]) {
                    bitmap = tool[2];
                    width = 32;
                    height = 32;
                    x = ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                        @ tool[0]).width / 2 - width / 2 - (tool[4] ? 2 : 0);
                    this.defaultY = y = ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                        @ tool[0]).height / 2 - height / 2 - (tool[4] ? 2 : 0);
                    this.toolData = tool;
                    thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseEnter", "onAddOutline");
                    thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseLeave", "onRemoveOutline");
                    thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseDown", "onToolSelected");
                    thiso.catchEvent(name, "OnMouseup", "onResetContainerPos");
                    alpha = thiso.default_iconAlpha;
                } // Tool Icon
                new GuiControl("Staffpanel_HotkeyContainer_"
                    @ tool[0]) {
                    useOwnProfile = true;
                    profile.opaque = true;
                    profile.border = 0;
                    profile.borderColor = "slategray";
                    profile.borderThickness = 1;
                    this.defColor = profile.fillColor = {
                        0,
                        0,
                        0,
                        0
                    };
                    width = 15;
                    height = 15;
                    x = ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                        @ tool[0]).width - width;
                    y = ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                        @ tool[0]).height - height;
                    visible = (tool[4] ? true : false);
                    active = false;
                    new GuiMLTextCtrl("Staffpanel_HotkeyText_"
                        @ tool[0]) {
                        profile = GuiBlueMLTextProfile;
                        useOwnProfile = true;
                        profile.textshadow = true;
                        text = "<center><b><font color=magenta>"
                        @ tool[4];
                        x = 0;
                        y = 0;
                        width = ("Staffpanel_HotkeyContainer_"
                            @ tool[0]).width;
                        height = ("Staffpanel_HotkeyContainer_"
                            @ tool[0]).height;
                    } // Hotkey Text
                } // Hotkey Container
            } // Tool Container
            temp.newX += ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                @tool[0]).width + 1;
            findObject("Staffpanel").width += 41;
            thiso.scheduleEvent(0 + delay, "Animate", ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                @ tool[0]), "fadein", 0.25, "");
            temp.delay += 0.05;
        } // For all Tools
        new GuiControl("Staffpanel_InfoPanel") {
            useOwnProfile = true;
            profile.opaque = true;
            profile.border = 0;
            profile.borderColor = "slategray";
            profile.fillColor = {
                0,
                0,
                0,
                150
            };
            x = 1;
            y = 1;
            width = Staffpanel.width - 3;
            height = 20;
            new GuiMLTextCtrl("Staffpanel_InfoLine") {
                profile = GuiBlueMLTextProfile;
                useOwnProfile = true;
                profile.textshadow = true;
                text = thiso.default_textStyle @ thiso.default_text;
                x = 1;
                y = 2;
                width = ("Staffpanel_InfoPanel").width - 4;
                height = ("Staffpanel_InfoPanel").height;
            } // Info Text
            active = false;
        } // Info Container
        ("Staffpanel_Wallpaper").width = Staffpanel.width;
        ("Staffpanel_Wallpaper").height = Staffpanel.height;
    } // Staffpanel
} // onDrawPanel();
function onAnimate(ctr, ani, dur, tim) {
    with(findObject(ctr).createAnimation()) {
        transition = ani;
        duration = dur;
        timing = tim;
    } // Animation
} // onAnimate();
function onAddOutline(o) {
    with(findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
        @ o.toolData[0]))) {
        profile.border = 4;
    } // Find the Object
    ("Staffpanel_InfoLine").text = "<center>"
    @ thiso.default_textStyle @ o.toolData[3];
    findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolIcon_"
        @ o.toolData[0])).alpha = 1;
} // onAddOutline();
function onRemoveOutline(o) {
    findObject(o).y = findObject(o).defaultY;
    temp.tpc = findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
        @ o.toolData[0]));
    with(findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
        @ o.toolData[0]))) {
        if (tpc.profile.fillColor != "0,255,0,150") {
            profile.border = 0;
        }
    } // Find the Object
    ("Staffpanel_InfoLine").text = thiso.default_textStyle @ thiso.default_text;
    if (tpc.profile.fillColor != "0,255,0,150") {
        findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolIcon_"
            @ o.toolData[0])).alpha = thiso.default_iconAlpha;
    } //
} // onRemoveOutline();
function onResetContainerPos(o) {
    findObject(o).y = findObject(o).defaultY;
} // onResetContainerPos();
function GraalControl.onResize() {
    Staffpanel.y = ChatBar.y - Staffpanel.height - 5;
} // Graal was Resized
function ChatBar.onTextChanged(txt) {
    if (txt = "") return;
    if (client.toggle.typewriter = false) return;
    player.chat = ChatBar.text;
    if (player.chat.starts(":")) {
        player.chat = "";
    }
    if (player.chat.starts("/")) {
        player.chat = "";
    }
    if (player.chat.starts("warpt")) {
        player.chat = "";
    }
    if (player.chat.starts("setbody")) {
        player.chat = "";
    }
    if (player.chat.starts("sethead")) {
        player.chat = "";
    }
    if (player.chat.starts("setnick")) {
        player.chat = "";
    }
} // Typewriter
function switchLight(tdata, cfunc) {
    if (!(cfunc in {
            "drag",
            "boots",
            "block"
        })) return;
    temp.tpc = findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
        @ tdata));
    if (tpc.profile.fillColor == "0,0,0,150") {
        tpc.profile.fillColor = "0,255,0,150";
        findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolIcon_"
            @ tdata)).alpha = 1;
        findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
            @ tdata)).profile.border = 4;
    } else {
        tpc.profile.fillColor = tpc.defColor;
        findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolIcon_"
            @ tdata)).alpha = thiso.default_iconAlpha;
        findObject(("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
            @ tdata)).profile.border = 0;
    }
} // Switch the Light of a Toggle

function onTimeOut() {
    if (this.tool.boots) {
        for (temp.i = 0; temp.i < 4; temp.i++) {
            if (keydown(temp.i)) {
                player.x += vecx(temp.i) * thiso.bootSpeed;
                player.y += vecy(temp.i) * thiso.bootSpeed;
            } // Speed
        } // Player Direction Detection
    } // Boots
    if (client.curEffect.starts("stealth")) {
        for (temp.i = 0; temp.i < 4; temp.i++) {
            if (keydown(temp.i)) {
                player.x += vecx(temp.i) * 0.1;
                player.y += vecy(temp.i) * 0.1;
            } // Speed
        } // Player Direction Detection
    }
    if (this.tool.block == true) {
        showImg(200, "block.png", int(mousex), int(mousey));
    } else hideimgs(200, 205);
    if (Worlds_ChatBar.visible) {
        Staffpanel.y = Worlds_ChatBar.y - Staffpanel.height - 5;
    }
    else if(ChatBar.visible) {
        Staffpanel.y = ChatBar.y - Staffpanel.height - 5;
    }
    else if(graalreloaded) {
        Staffpanel.y = ChatBar.y - Staffpanel.height;
    } else Staffpanel.y = GraalControl.height - Staffpanel.height - 15;
    if(this.curDrag.length() > 0) {
      player.chat = "sent " @ timevar2 SPC this.curDrag.length();
      triggerServer("gui", name, "dragPlayer", this.curDrag, mousex, mousey);
    }// Dragging a Player
    settimer(.05);
} // onTimeOut();
function GraalControl.onMouseUp() {
    if (this.curDrag != null) {
        triggerServer("gui", name, "dropPlayer", this.curDrag);
        this.curDrag = {};
    } // Drop the Dragging-Player
} // Mouse was Released
function GraalControl.onMouseDown() {
    if (this.tool.drag == true) {
        this.curDrag = getPlayer2(mousex, mousey);
    } // Dragging a Player
    if (this.tool.block == true) {
        triggerServer("gui", name, "placeBlock", int(mousex), int(mousey));
    } // Placing a Block
} // Mouse Clicked
function GraalControl.onMouseDragged() {
    if (this.curDrag != null) {
        triggerServer("gui", name, "dragPlayer", this.curDrag, mousex, mousey);
    } // Dragging a Player
} // Mouse was Dragged
function GraalControl.onRightMouseDown() {
    triggerAction(mousex, mousey, "Remove", player.account, player.communityname);
} // Right Mouse Click
function getPlayer2(tX, tY) {
    for (temp.i = 0; temp.i < players.size(); temp.i++) {
        if (tX in | players[i].x, players[i].x + 3 | && tY in | players[i].y, players[i].y + 3 | ) {
            return players[i].account;
        } // Player in Coordinates
    } // For all Players
    return "";
} // getPlayer2();
function onToolSelected(o) {
    temp.toolFunc = o.toolData[1];
    if (toolFunc == null) temp.toolFunc = o;
    findObject(o).y += 2;
    switchLight(o.toolData[0], toolFunc);
    switch (toolFunc) {
        case "close":
            return Staffpanel.visible = false;
        case "boots":
            return this.tool.boots = !this.tool.boots;
        case "drag":
            return this.tool.drag = !this.tool.drag;
        case "block":
            return this.tool.block = !this.tool.block;
    } // Switch
} // onToolSelected
function GraalControl.onKeyDown() {
    switch (params[1]) {
        case 2: {
            Staffpanel.visible = true;
            onResetToggles();
            for (temp.tool: this.staffLinks) {
                thiso.scheduleEvent(0 + delay, "Animate", ("Staffpanel_ToolContainer_"
                    @ tool[0]), "fadein", 0.25, "");
                temp.delay += 0.05;
            }
            break;
        } // Open Panel
        case "z": {
            this.tool.boots = !this.tool.boots;
            switchLight("Boots", "boots");
            break;
        } // Boots
        case "x": {
            this.tool.drag = !this.tool.drag;
            switchLight("Drag", "drag");
            break;
        } // Drag
        case "c": {
            this.tool.block = !this.tool.block;
            switchLight("Block", "block");
            break;
        }
    }
}
SCRIPTEND
